data.gender_notes: Makrand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Makrand is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Mahakala' or 'Mahakalp', meaning 'Lord of Time'. In Hindu mythology, Mahakala is a form of Shiva, the god of destruction, who is also considered the lord of time. The name Makrand is believed to evoke the qualities of power, stability, and timelessness. The name Makrand carries the meaning “Lord of Time” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Makrand usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of time and live with faith, good character and purpose.
